source.title: Epic Armaments of Battle - Exalted Amongst the Dawn
source.description:
Greetings, friend. Have you insignias of the Dawn or the Crusade that you would like to redeem for items of great power?

Those exalted amongst the Dawn receive our greatest discounts! I encourage you to make a purchase.
source.objective: For 27 Insignias of the Dawn and 27 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.
source.progress: Choose carefully. There are no refunds.
source.completion: Good day, <name>. It was a pleasure doing business with you.
